messages:
Priya (CSM): FYI: Cobalt Systems renewal conversation flagged. Usage down ~65% MoM; champion left, new Eng Manager Alyssa asking for perf/cost comparisons. NovaAI pilot mentioned. :warning:
Tomas (AM): Thanks — which routes are most impacted? embeddings, chat, rerank?
Priya (CSM): Mostly batch embeddings and reranking. Daily token volume went from ~120k -> ~42k. I'm pulling the quick usage slice now.
Priya (CSM): ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'cobalt'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Alex (Solutions Eng): Useful. Also want to validate p50/p95/p99 across their typical seq lengths — NovaAI looks cheaper on token unit cost but our p99 for long contexts was worse in a public bench last month.
Jordan (Sales): Do we have an active paid pilot or just eval logs? Renewal in ~6 weeks; need a quick commercial play if they escalate.
Priya (CSM): Right now Hosted eval only. They spun up a Dedicated trial but paused after champion left. I'm lining up a call with Alyssa Monday 10am PT.
Tomas (AM): Action: assemble a one-pager for Monday — 1) recent usage trend, 2) perf numbers by seq len, 3) cost delta vs NovaAI for their workload, 4) proposed short-term offer. Who owns which piece?
Alex (Solutions Eng): I can do perf slices + simple charts. Need anonymized prompt samples and avg seq len distribution. Priya, can you DM those?
Priya (CSM): Sending prompts in DM now. Also will include a small set of failed examples they've shared.
Jordan (Sales): I'll draft short commercial options: 2-week dedicated bench + credit, or a 3-month reserved discount. Position as "performance validation" to reduce procurement noise. :thumbsup:
eng-bot: deploy 1749127000 tagged cobalt-dedicated-bench started; estimated completion 3h
Priya (CSM): Owners = Priya (overall), Alex (perf analysis), Jordan (commercial). Goal: call Monday, 1-pager by EOD Sunday. Any blockers?
Alex (Solutions Eng): None yet. Will have perf slides by Sunday afternoon.
Tomas (AM): + please include a quick playbook for onboarding Alyssa — she asked about integration effort and security controls.
Priya (CSM): Noted — I'll add integration checklist and current SSO/KMS notes.
Tomas (AM): Suggest adding 1-2 customer quotes/case snippets where we solved similar perf/cost concerns. Helps with trust.
Priya (CSM): Good idea. I'll pull 2 anonymized examples. Draft coming in #dm with Alex and Jordan for review.
Jordan (Sales): If Monday call flags procurement, I'll loop legal and solutions to fast-track a short-term SOW.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — will update thread after call scheduling.
